description: Mixpanel user profile updates posted to /engage. /track is vendor/mixpanel. /import is vendor/mixpanel-import. /groups is vendor/mixpanel-groups.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Mixpanel documents `verbose=1` so the 200 body says whether the update was accepted.
params.fix_hint: Send `verbose=1` on `/engage` while you are implementing.

params.name: strict
params.description: Mixpanel documents `strict=1` so failed records are named in the response.
params.fix_hint: Send `strict=1` to see per-record validation errors.

params.name: ip
params.description: Mixpanel documents `ip=0` on server-side calls so the profile is not geolocated to your server.

params.name: data
params.description: The official browser SDK encodes the event or profile update in data for the legacy base64 transport.
The JSON body is a nonempty array of records.

params.name: $token
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$token` as required. It is the project token.
params.fix_hint: Send the project token from Mixpanel project settings as `$token`.

params.name: $distinct_id
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$distinct_id` as required. It must be the same id you send on events.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `distinct_id` you use on `/track` for this user.

params.name: $set
params.description: Sets profile properties, creating the profile if needed. Mixpanel documents it as required for the profile-set call.

params.name: $set_once
params.description: Sets profile properties only when they are not already set.

params.name: $add
params.description: Increments numeric profile properties.

params.name: $union
params.description: Unions list profile properties.

params.name: $append
params.description: Appends to list profile properties.

params.name: $remove
params.description: Removes values from list profile properties.

params.name: $unset
params.description: Unsets named profile properties.

params.name: $delete
params.description: Deletes the profile.

params.name: $ip
params.description: Mixpanel uses `$ip` to geolocate the profile. Send a raw address, not a digest.

params.name: $time
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$time` as seconds since epoch for the profile update.
params.fix_hint: Send a Unix timestamp in seconds, not milliseconds and not an ISO string.

params.name: $ignore_time
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$ignore_time` as a boolean. `true` leaves Last Seen unchanged.
The vendor documents `` in the request contract.

params.name: $unset[]
params.description: The vendor documents `$unset[]` in the request contract.

params.name: increment
params.description: The vendor documents `increment` in the request contract.

params.name: union
params.description: The vendor documents `union` in the request contract.

rules.message: `$ip` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Mixpanel documents it as an IP address used for geolocation.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address, or omit `$ip`.

rules.message: The profile update has no operation. Mixpanel documents `$set`, `$set_once`, `$add`, `$union`, `$append`, `$remove`, `$unset`, or `$delete`.
rules.fix_hint: Send `$set` with the properties to write, or another documented engage operator.
